transcript:
Speaker A (AI): Hi, what is your name?
Speaker B (Man): My name is Sandy.
Speaker A (AI): How old are you?
Speaker B (Man): I have twenty four.
Speaker A (AI): Sandy, "I have twenty four" galat hai. Sahi tarika hai "I am twenty four years old". [Sandy, "I have twenty four" is wrong. The correct way is "I am twenty four years old".]
Speaker B (Man): Okay, I am twenty four years old.
Speaker A (AI): Where are you from?
Speaker B (Man): I am Uttar Pradesh.
Speaker A (AI): "I am Uttar Pradesh" mat bolo. Sahi sentence hai "I am from Uttar Pradesh". [Don't say "I am Uttar Pradesh". The correct sentence is "I am from Uttar Pradesh".]
Speaker B (Man): Oh! Theek hai. Meri English bahut weak hai. [Oh! Okay. My English is very weak.]
Speaker A (AI): Koi baat nahi, main aapki help ke liye hi hoon. Kya aapne kabhi kisi AI teacher se padhai ki hai? [No problem, I am here to help you. Have you ever studied with an AI teacher?]
Speaker B (Man): Par woh toh bahut mehnge hote honge. [But those must be very expensive.]
Speaker A (AI): Bilkul nahi. SpeakEasy app normal classes se 7x jyada sasta hai. Isliye 1 crore se jyada log yahan English practice karte hain. [Not at all. SpeakEasy app is 7x cheaper than normal classes. That's why over 1 crore people practice English here.]
Speaker B (Man): Par mere paas practice ka time kahan hai? [But where do I have time to practice?]
Speaker A (AI): Din mein sirf 15 minute kaafi hain. Aap bahut jaldi confident ho jaoge. [Just 15 minutes a day is enough. You will become confident very quickly.]
Speaker B (Man): Wow! Main kaise join karoon? [Wow! How do I join?]
Speaker A (AI): Bas is install button ko dabao aur SpeakEasy app download karo. Sirf 15 din mein aapko fark dikhega. [Just press this install button and download the SpeakEasy app. You will see a difference in just 15 days.]
Speaker C (Woman): Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
